findings.title: Vehicle import wizard and engine exist but are unwired; sheet button disabled with a false 'no implementation' claim
findings.observed: VehicleImportWizard (314 SLOC, template preloaded) has zero importers; VehicleImportEngine is reachable only from the debug scratch import. The sheet disables the import-vehicle button asserting no implementation exists. Tests read the wizard source as text only.
findings.intendedOwnership: C-VEH-2: sheet action -> VehicleImportWizard.create -> VehicleImportEngine.apply -> ActorEngine.updateActor
findings.proposedSolution: Owner decides: wire import-vehicle to VehicleImportWizard.create({actor}) (wizard already fail-closed via engine) or retire wizard (class C) and keep engine for debug. Update the stale sheet comment either way.
findings.alternatives: Open wizard from Holopad/Shell Host asset bay instead of the sheet.
findings.regressionTests: Test that the import-vehicle action resolves to the wizard and that the engine refuses non-canonical documents (existing tests/vehicle-universal-phase4c-import-source.test.mjs).
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: import a published vehicle into a vehicle actor; verify statblock replace and source identity.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes a dead 314-SLOC app or restores a documented feature; removes contradictory comment.

findings.title: createItem hook grants Starship Tactics maneuvers outside the progression shell; recursion guard key never set
findings.observed: On any feat named like 'starship tactics' created on the creating client, the hook opens a selection dialog and creates maneuver Items plus sets system.starshipManeuverSuite. The progression framework has its own starship-maneuver step and finalizer writes to starshipManeuverSuite. The hook's guard checks options.meta.guardKey==='starship-maneuver-grant' but grantManeuvers never passes it; createItem has no mutation-in-flight guard (updateActor does).
findings.intendedOwnership: A-15: maneuver choices live in progression draft state and are committed once by ProgressionFinalizer; non-progression feat grants route to a progression entry, not a hook dialog.
findings.proposedSolution: Restrict the hook to non-progression creations (skip when ActorEngine.isActorMutationInFlight or a progression source option is present) or remove it and launch the progression starship-maneuver step on out-of-progression grants. Pass the guard key from grantManeuvers.
findings.alternatives: Keep hook but convert to a notification prompting the player to open the progression shell.
findings.regressionTests: Test: finalizing chargen with Starship Tactics creates maneuvers exactly once and opens no dialog; adding the feat via sheet drop takes the approved path.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: chargen with Starship Tactics; level-up adding it; GM drop of the feat.
findings.simplificationBenefit: One maneuver grant path instead of two.
findings.risk: Progression finalization runtime-risk; duplicate grants possible.

findings.title: Two spend paths for starship maneuvers with different semantics
findings.observed: Vehicle sheet useManeuver writes system.discarded=true on the crew/vehicle item without a roll; the character sheet uses StarshipManeuverSuite.activateManeuver (Pilot activation check, then discarded). Regain on the vehicle sheet already delegates to the suite.
findings.intendedOwnership: StarshipManeuverSuite is the single maneuver use/regain authority; vehicle sheet is a view/adapter.
findings.proposedSolution: Route vehicle-sheet use through StarshipManeuverSuite.activateManeuver(pilot,itemId); keep StarshipManeuversEngine as list builder only. If a manual 'mark spent' GM tool is wanted, owner must say so.
findings.alternatives: Keep manual toggle as GM-only override with explicit label.
findings.regressionTests: Test that vehicle-sheet use invokes the suite and produces a Pilot activation roll.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: use maneuver from vehicle Pilot station.
findings.risk: Low; behavior change visible to players.

findings.title: Engine to UI: crew assignment service opens a dialog; pure modules misplaced under UI directories
findings.observed: VehicleCrewAssignmentService builds HTML and calls SWSEDialogV2.prompt inside the service (real violation). crew-resolver.js, weapon-station-mapping.js and effect-intent-engine.js contain no DOM access; they are domain logic in UI directories (layering-only probe hits).
findings.intendedOwnership: Engine returns candidates; sheet/controller presents the picker and calls assignCrew.
findings.proposedSolution: Move the picker (content + prompt) to scripts/sheets/v2/vehicle-sheet/vehicle-crew-assignment-controls.js; relocate crew-resolver and weapon-station-mapping to scripts/domain/vehicles/, effect-intent-engine to scripts/engine/effects/ (path moves, imports rerouted).
findings.alternatives: Inject a prompt function into the service.
findings.regressionTests: Existing tests/phase6-vehicle-crew-assignment.test.mjs plus a dependency test asserting no scripts/engine/** import of scripts/apps|sheets|dialogs for these files.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: assign crew via picker.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes 4 of 6 vehicle A-07 probe hits.

findings.title: Three-file static import cycle in the Shipyard ledger
findings.observed: ledger -> effects (EFFECTS) -> runtime-contract (getVehiclePublishedFieldState) -> ledger (readCertifiedInstallations). getVehiclePublishedFieldState is a pure function with no dependencies.
findings.intendedOwnership: C-VEH-1 acyclic: effects and field-state helpers below ledger, runtime-contract above.
findings.proposedSolution: Move getVehiclePublishedFieldState to a new pure module (e.g. scripts/domain/vehicles/vehicle-published-field-state.js) re-exported from runtime-contract; effects imports it directly.
findings.alternatives: Move EFFECTS to its own constants module.
findings.regressionTests: Import-graph test asserting no cycle among scripts/domain/vehicles/**.
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes one of 9 static cycles; ESM init order no longer matters.

findings.title: Party Fund ammunition debit outside TransactionEngine (owner workflow vs A-10); notification via raw ChatMessage
findings.observed: GM approval settles by PartyFundAccess.setBalance + appendLedger, then delivers; failure restores the snapshot; unprovable restore -> indeterminate. Owner-approved as workflow V-P6C-19, but A-10 (OSI) says TransactionEngine is the single credit authority with no parallel ledgers. Whisper uses globalThis.ChatMessage.create (A-05).
findings.intendedOwnership: A-10: TransactionEngine owns all credit movement including party funds.
findings.proposedSolution: Owner decides whether Party Fund is in A-10 scope. If yes: add a TransactionEngine party-fund transaction (debit + ledger + delivery callback) and route this settlement through it. Route the whisper through SWSEChat.
findings.alternatives: Record Party Fund as a documented A-10 exception owned by holonet.
findings.regressionTests: Existing p51/p52/p53 tests plus a test that settlement calls TransactionEngine.
findings.foundryAcceptance: Live V13: approve Party Fund request; forced delivery failure restores fund.

findings.title: Undeclared tracked vehicle pack artefacts and a stale branch-pinned workflow
findings.observed: vehicles-canonical-ships (.db + tracked LevelDB dir, .gitignore exempts it), vehicles-starships.db, vehicles-weapon-emplacements.db and vehicles.db are tracked but undeclared; the phase4c checkpoint calls them retired historical input; canonical-ship-pack.yml still commits to feat/vehicle-canonical-census-cutover. The other 9 committed packs/vehicles-*.db are also never read by the release build for vehicles. Readers: node tools and audit reports only.
findings.intendedOwnership: C-VEH-2: data/canonical/vehicles/vehicles.json is the single vehicle source.
findings.proposedSolution: Legacy class B (referenced by tools/tests): reroute tools/vehicles/build-canonical-ships.mjs, inspect-packs.js and validate-content-completeness to the canonical source, retire canonical-ship-pack.yml, then delete the undeclared artefacts (class C). Owner decides whether the 9 retired declared-name .db files stay as historical input.
findings.alternatives: Move them to an archive directory.
findings.simplificationBenefit: ~8 MB of retired pack data and one workflow removed; one vehicle source.
findings.risk: Low; compendium-shape runtime-risk only if a world references the old pack ids.

findings.title: Orphan vehicle modules
findings.observed: No static/dynamic importer, no template/pack/global reference (grep of scripts, templates, packs). The legacy normalizers are explicitly forbidden from running (tests assert absence of calls); modification-factory predates the sealed ledger planner; category registry is superseded by universal-vehicle-pack-registry. Several tests read normalizer source as text.
findings.proposedSolution: Class C deletion candidates after rewriting the text-reading pins (tests/phase2c_cp8_vehicle_import_source_fields.test.mjs, tests/phase2c-vehicle-live-roll-guard.test.mjs, tests/phase2c-vehicle-source-integrity-guards.test.mjs) to assert absence.
findings.regressionTests: Updated pins assert the files are gone and no runtime path calls them.

findings.title: Deprecated VehicleInstallationService.install wrapper with no callers
findings.observed: install(args) forwards to gmInstantInstall; grep finds no callers in scripts or tests.
findings.proposedSolution: Class D: delete the wrapper (check macros/packs once more).
findings.simplificationBenefit: Removes an alias that hides a GM override.

findings.title: Starship maneuver manager recomputes the Wisdom modifier from raw base when derived is absent
findings.observed: Three sites fall back to floor((wis.base-10)/2), ignoring species/enhancement modifiers; handleAbilityIncrease compares raw base values only.
findings.intendedOwnership: Ability modifiers come from actor derived attributes (actor-core).
findings.proposedSolution: Read only system.derived.attributes.wis.mod; if absent, refuse/defer rather than recompute.
findings.alternatives: Call the actor-core ability modifier helper.
findings.regressionTests: Test with a species Wisdom bonus: suite size uses the derived modifier.
